blocks.text: Buying a Home in Garrison Crossing, Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Garrison Crossing

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Garrison Boulevard, Keith Wilson Road, Market Way, Vedder Road, and South Sumas Road. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Garrison Crossing will find master-planned craftsman-style detached houses with rear lane access, rowhomes, strata townhomes, and low-rise condos steps from Garrison Village grocery, cafes, and medical services. blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Garrison Crossing

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Garrison Crossing are served by Vedder Elementary, Watson Elementary, Mt. Slesse Middle, Vedder Middle, G.W. Graham Secondary, and the University of the Fraser Valley (UFV) Chilliwack Campus at Canada Education Park. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Cheam Leisure Centre (pool, aquatic centre, and gym at 45501 Market Way), Legacy Regional Park, the Vedder River Rotary Trail, and tree-lined boulevards throughout the 153-acre master-planned community. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 51 (Vedder Road / UFV Chilliwack Campus), Route 54 (Promontory), and Route 58 (Tyson Road).

How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Garrison Crossing?

Key road corridors serving Garrison Crossing include Garrison Boulevard, Keith Wilson Road, Market Way, Vedder Road, and South Sumas Road. Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 51 (Vedder Road / UFV Chilliwack Campus), Route 54 (Promontory), and Route 58 (Tyson Road).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Garrison Crossing?

Properties in Garrison Crossing are governed by the former CFB Chilliwack master-planned redevelopment guidelines, the South Vedder Neighbourhood Plan, and Vedder River Alluvial Fan flood construction levels. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Garrison Crossing freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Garrison Crossing are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
